Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Patna Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Patna recruitment is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Project Assistant (PA).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Project Assistant (PA) posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: For SRF, candidates need M Tech/MSc/ME/ B Tech-M Tech Dual degree in relevant Civil Engineering fields with experience, or a B.Tech in Civil Engineering with significant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: For PA, candidates require a B.Sc. or equivalent degree, or a 3-Year Diploma in Engineering & Technology with a minimum CPI of 6.5 or 60% marks.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The selected Senior Research Fellow (SRF) will receive a salary of Rs. 41,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (PA) position?
faq.answer: The selected Project Assistant (PA) will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply by sending their application via email to the address specified in the official notification before the closing date.
